description: This file is an HTML webpage for a database visualizer interface. It contains structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript code to load and display database lists, tables, and data dynamically, providing an interactive UI for browsing database contents.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a single cell, handling long text and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
